inventory_boundary.source_ref: The complete seven-page public manuscript PDF and its TeX source bundle were read, but both explicitly cite an unavailable Supplemental Material file.
inventory_boundary.reason: The missing Supplement contains indispensable formulas and may contain additional displays or quantitative claims, so the 80 enumerated main-manuscript items are a known lower bound rather than a complete whole-paper inventory.
inventory_boundary.next_action: Obtain the public Supplement, enumerate any additional figures, tables, and independent quantitative claims, then reconcile this lower-bound inventory without using author code, author arrays, or source pixels as scientific inputs.
